title: Bronze Tank
description: <keyword>Bronze tanks</keyword> can store <keyword>4 buckets of fluid</keyword> each, you can use them to interact with machines, and you can place them in the world.
When placed in the world, you can <positive>right-click</positive> them with <keyword>buckets or other tanks</keyword> to transfer fluids.
Also, you can <positive>stack them</positive> in your inventory if they have the same contents. How nifty!
